description: This file defines a set of React components that wrap and customize radix-ui's primitive tabs components, providing styled tab interface elements such as Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, and TabsContent.

methods.name: Tabs
methods.description: A React component wrapping radix-ui's TabsPrimitive.Root with additional className styling.

methods.name: TabsList
methods.description: A React component wrapping radix-ui's TabsPrimitive.List with styling for the list of tabs.

methods.name: TabsTrigger
methods.description: A React component wrapping radix-ui's TabsPrimitive.Trigger, styled as a clickable tab button.

methods.name: TabsContent
methods.description: A React component wrapping radix-ui's TabsPrimitive.Content for the tab content area.
